title: Tiled attention with an online softmax
summary: FlashAttention in numpy: a running max and a running sum over key blocks give exact attention for any block size.

paper.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness

mutants.block_max_only: Sets the running max to the max of the current block only, so scores far apart in two blocks overflow.
mutants.causal_blocks_diagonal: Blocks key j when j >= i, so each query also blocks itself and the first row has no allowed key.
mutants.no_neginf_guard: Uses a running max of minus infinity inside the exponentials, so a fully masked block gives NaN.
mutants.no_rescale_acc: Forgets to scale the old accumulator by exp(old max minus new max).
mutants.no_rescale_sum: Forgets to scale the old running sum by exp(old max minus new max).
mutants.partial_block_dropped: Stops the loop before a last block that is shorter than block_size.
